description: This Kotlin source file defines the CameraHandler class, which manages camera operations such as listing devices, taking snapshots, and recording clips within an Android application. It includes functions for handling camera interactions, logging, payload size validation, and error handling.

classes.name: CameraHandler
classes.description: A class that handles camera operations such as listing devices, capturing photos, and recording video clips, with integrated logging and error handling.

methods.name: handleList
methods.description: Lists available camera devices and returns their details in JSON format.

methods.name: handleSnap
methods.description: Captures a photo using the camera, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: handleClip
methods.description: Records a video clip, encodes it in base64, and returns the payload, with size validation and error handling.

methods.description: Parses the 'includeAudio' parameter from JSON input.
